title: Fastest way to Kuldra | 22 min 35 sec to finish dungeon | Patch 1.0.1.2
author: David The Optimist Gaming
offsetMethod: detected: end of the loading screen into the raid

anomalies.name: Fragments of Ghornfell
anomalies.description: Fragments of Ghornfell: 52.9 s — 8.2 s faster than every reference run (best TexasPete 61.1 s).  Possible skip or route not in the reference set.

textNotes.text: It took me 22 min 35 sec to finish the dungeon. You'll find here all the skips I did so you can be more efficient.

textNotes.author: @SvG_Tokez8184
textNotes.text: same thing for me, that gate just stays open, to be honest its welcomed, i wish we could just skip to the fight and not have to rerun everything to grind items with a low drop rate

textNotes.author: @davidtheoptimistgaming
textNotes.text: Oh well, maybe the devs will have this in mind for future dungeons. Right now, I would want them to focus on fixing the bugs and leave this dungeon as it is.

textNotes.author: @davidtheoptimistgaming
textNotes.text: Cast Surge and Phase Dash. Use Surge when you start. Then jump. Then 2x Phase Dash. It should work.

textNotes.author: @Anunnaki2522
textNotes.text: With the recent change that "fixed" the other skips whats faster now?
